Name: Nyapu Style Portraits for They Deserve it Too - East Scarp
Author: Howaa
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48630]They Deserve It Too - East Scarp[/url] using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url]'s style as a base.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
This is a file replacement mod! So you'll need to navigate to your mod folder, find "TDIT Portraits For East Scarp", and drag my "TDIT - Portraits for East Scarp" folder into your mod folder, allow my portraits to overwrite the originals, and you're done! 

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI, Dead Boy Detectives 

[b]Shout outs[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for their art, their beautiful mod page cover (which I edited to create the one above), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48630]They Deserve It Too - East Scarp[/url] & permission to upload these retextures, and as always [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for their portraits & generous permissions and of course [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/lemurkat?gameId=1303]lemurkat[/url] for East Scarp

Mods  used in the cover image - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23647]Shane UI[/url] (slightly recolored by me for a personal edit) & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42851]Seasonal Portrait Backgrounds[/url]
